summary.zh-CN: 面向 DSH Agent 会话的项目需求追溯、分阶段执行、人工审核与交付看板。
summary.en-US: Project traceability, staged agent execution, human review, and delivery workflow for DSH sessions.

network: Local DSH web profile HTTP route prefix /taskboard only
filesystem: Read/write persistent taskboard state and its recovery backup under $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-taskboard (overridable via DSH_TASKBOARD_DATA); read the legacy package-local data file once for non-destructive migration

Create isolated per-task Git worktrees under the taskboard runtime data directory; remove them after successful integration, deletion, force-close, or explicit history cleanup while retaining session logs
Update a registered workspace only during serialized rebase and fast-forward integration; retain conflict state in the task-owned worktree for same-session resolution
process: Run git with explicit argument arrays under registered workspaces and task-owned worktrees (worktree, status, temporary-index read-tree/write-tree/commit-tree baseline capture, add, commit, rebase/rebase --continue, merge --ff-only, branch, rev-parse and cleanup)
